official_source_checks.finding: Usage/deletion data covers opted-in diagnostic/usage sharing, not all users.
Statistics and acquisition CSV exports use private GCS; devstorage.read_only and Play account permissions must be verified separately.
drive.file plus Google Picker grants selected-file access; OAuth metadata access alone is not a content download grant.

corrections: Apple Ads read and derived CPI/CPT/CR/TTR already exist.
Supplied cohort CAC and useful-value retention and subscription conversion already exist.
RevenueCat overview is not exact individual LTV or an MMP identity join.
No assumption that existing Android Publisher permission grants GCS analytics download.
